about_the_game:
🌞 Welcome to Sunny Orchard! 🍇


Step into the sunlit charm of your very own fruit orchard! Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and expand your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations, all while collecting adorable premium fruit stickers to show the quality and care behind your fancy produce.

🍎 Grow & Maintain
Plant seeds, water crops, keep pests away, and harvest fruit through relaxing mini-games. Manage both trees and seasonal plants, expanding your orchard to fit more as you grow.

📦 Package & Deliver
Sort, box, and label your produce at the Packaging Station. Fulfill customer orders in your shop, from the local bakery owner to the neighborhood smoothie bar.

🛒 Expand & Upgrade
Shop online at night to buy seeds, farming supplies, automation tools, and land expansions. Unlock special upgrades like:
• Greenhouse – Grow crops year-round
• Juice Station – Blend fruits into high-value juices
• Jam Kitchen – Turn extra produce into preserves

✨ Features
• Cozy orchard management with colorful, wholesome visuals
• Fun mini-games for planting, watering, pest control, harvesting, and packaging
• Collectible premium fruit stickers to boost your brand’s charm
• Friendly NPC customers with unique personalities and requests
• Decorative customization for your orchard and shop

🍓 Add Sunny Orchard to your Wishlist now! 🍓

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
